recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male figure in a dark jacket and light denim, set against a soft-focus sunset background, featuring bold vertical red typography and geometric crosshair motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text anchoring the left third of the frame
Subject centered with hands in pockets creating a triangular silhouette
High-contrast red text against a muted, warm-toned natural background
Graphic geometric overlays contrasting with organic photographic textures
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of primary display text
Distressed or weathered texture on large-scale lettering
Circular crosshair graphic with diagonal intersecting lines
Warm sunset backlighting creating a rim-light effect on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-shot portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red vertical text on the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vertical text, moves to the subject's face, then follows the diagonal lines of the crosshair graphics.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus background provides breathing room around the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones and blues (jacket, jeans, background trees).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and yellow (highlights, graphic lines, sunset glow).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text; low to medium saturation in the photographic elements with high value contrast in the sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to naturalistic photographic tones plus one primary graphic color

characterSpecificRedesigns: Apply a 'grunge' or 'weathered' mask to the red fill to simulate ink wear
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small-scale sans-serif inside graphic elements for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thin white circular lines with intersecting 45-degree diagonals
Small rectangular blocks containing secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, square-terminal aesthetic of 80s display type.
Provides a similar industrial, bold feel with slightly more character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium portrait of a man with messy 80s hair wearing a dark leather jacket and light blue jeans, standing on a road at sunset. The background is a soft-focus bokeh of trees and a golden sky. Leave the left third of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertical, weathered red sans-serif text on the left. Overlay thin white circular crosshair graphics with diagonal lines in the top right and bottom left corners.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise?
Does the red text have a distressed texture?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to make the subject pop?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Authentic 80s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is the most saturated element.
Ensure the crosshair lines are thin and precise.
Verify the subject has a rim-light highlight from the sunset.
Confirm the vertical text is legible despite the distress.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Bold Sans + Distressed Red Fill + Sunset Portrait + Geometric Crosshair Overlays
